messages:
nina-fin: Heads-up: we received three customer tickets today about a sudden jump in token/embedding usage on last week's invoices. Looks correlated to SDK client version v2.1 rollout.

jorge-eng: seeing the alerts in metering too. dashboard shows a +28% token delta for embeddings between 2024-09-01 and 2024-09-03 for several customers using our hosted ingest.

priyanka-ml: preliminary root-cause: a third-party tokenizer lib bump bundled in SDK v2.1 changed how characters map to tokens for some multibyte inputs (emoji and CJK) which increased token counts for the embedding pipeline. The upstream change was unintentionally included in customer-facing SDK.

dan-infra: can confirm ingestion logs include sdk_user_agent: "redwood-sdk/2.1" for the spike window. We also have raw request payloads saved for affected accounts.

billing-bot: Alert: anomalous token/embedding delta for acct_204 (LumenX), acct_309 (BlueHarbor), acct_412 (ClipperAI). Tickets INC-4120, INC-4121, INC-4122 created.

nina-fin: do we have numbers? rough estimate at current pricing: LumenX +640k tokens, BlueHarbor +440k, ClipperAI +310k => combined ~1.39M tokens, ~$2,600 overcharge.

jorge-eng: safe mitigation: 1) release SDK v2.1.1 to revert tokenizer change and publish notice 2) run a recalculation/backfill that re-tokenizes payloads with the canonical tokenizer (sdk v2.0 behavior) for requests that came from sdk v2.1 during the window 3) produce per-account diffs for billing.

priyanka-ml: we have a reliable re-tokenizer in the eval infra that can be applied offline to stored inputs. Accuracy good; should match pre-2.1 counts. Note: we need customers' consent for reprocessing raw inputs for some regulated accounts; flagging for sales/legal if needed.

nina-fin: request: finance approval to issue provisional credits to the affected invoices while recalculation runs. Proposed provisional total $2,600. We'll reconcile after the backfill and either re-invoice or reverse credits.

rafael-finance: Approved provisional credits of $2,600. Add invoice note: "Provisional credit pending tokenization backfill verification." Billing ops to hold final ledger commit until backfill diff validated.

taylor-sales: I'll reach out to LumenX/BlueHarbor/ClipperAI with a short note: "We've identified an SDK tokenizer issue that affected usage reporting. We've issued a provisional credit while we verify and backfill. We'll follow up with final reconciliation." Keep it simple.

dan-infra: starting backfill job now. Job id: backfill-tokenizer-1815004321. Steps: 1) select requests where sdk_user_agent contains 'redwood-sdk/2.1' between '2024-09-01' and '2024-09-03' 2) re-run tokenization using canonical tokenizer 3) compare token counts, produce CSV: account_id, request_id, orig_tokens, new_tokens, token_delta. ETA ~4h. Will upload to s3://redwood-billing/replays/1815004321-tokenizer-backfill.csv

billing-bot: Backfill job queued: backfill-tokenizer-1815004321. Will post completion link and diff.

jorge-eng: also pushing a hotfix to the ingest path to tag SDK versions and prevent future silent tokenizer inheritance. Adding unit tests that compare token distribution against a baseline.

priyanka-ml: note: for customers who use customer-managed encryption/KMS and disallow reprocessing, we'll need to surface the issue to legal and propose a manual adjustment workflow. Flagging to @taylor-sales and finance.

nina-fin: ack. finance requests a list of affected accounts that require special handling. billing ops: once CSV is ready, please partition rows into normal vs restricted accounts so we can apply credits where allowed and escalate the rest.

dan-infra: backfill job started. will update when we upload the replay file.
